tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang skor brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ /āoṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/dge 'dun thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la dus thams cad du gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ gdod nas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*/ /yon tan phrin las rlabs che bas/ / 'khor 'das kun gyi dpal gyur pa/ /kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ / chos sku'i zhing las ma g.yos par/ /'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa yis/ /dpag med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam 'phrul las/ /rang byung gsang sngags kun gyi bdag /rig 'dzin kun gyi bla ma mchog /dga' rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ / thugs rje ye shes gru chen gyis/ /'khor ba'i chu bor rab bsgralazhing*/ /mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa la/ /mkhyen rab 'od stong rab 'phros pas/ /'jig rten gsum po snang mdzad pa/ /shrī sing ha la phyag 'tshal/ /skye shi med pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi yis/ /'gro ba'i don kun rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bi ma mi tra la phyag 'tshal/ / rnam grol gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo rab brtan zhing*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes/ /ting 'dzin bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse'i blo mig rab dag pas/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /rnam kun 'od gsal snying po brnyes/ /blo gros dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /zab cing rgya che'i rgya mtsho las/ /rang byung ye shes nor bu brnyes/ / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub/

/rin chen 'bar ba la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi byin rlabs las/ /dngos grub yid bzhin gter gyi bdag /bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /ldang ma lhun rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /snying po'i don la rab sbyangs pas/ /tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /'od lus grub nas mkha' la gshegs/ /seng ge dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /zab mo'i de nyid rab rtogs nas/ /ting 'dzin brtson pas 'khrul pa zhig /rlung sems dag pas 'od gsal brnyes/ /shong pa ras pa la phyag 'tshal/ /chos nyid don gyi mchog brnyes pa/ /rang byung ye shes dgongs pa la/ /'du 'bral med par lhun gyis grub/ /zab ston chos 'bar la phyag 'tshal/ /dgongs pa rang byung ye shes dang*/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa bla na med/ /dngos grub mchog gi snying por brnyes/ /dam pa dgyer zhig la phyag 'tshal/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor bzang po la/ /sbyangs pa'i blo mig rab dag pas/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i rgyal mtshan brnyes/ /shes rab rtse mo la phyag 'tshal/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs ma nyams shing*/ /gdams pa'i chu bo bzhi 'dus pas/ /smin grol lam la 'gro ba 'dren/ /sprul sku mched gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /rang don grub pa mchog brnyes nas/ /gzhan don phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /dgongs pa chos nyid bar mtshams med/ /nam mkha' rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /rang byung rtogs pa'i rtsal chen gyis/ /'khor 'das gzhi grol chos sku'i ngang*/ /gzhan don phrin las rlabs che ba/ /ku ma rā dza la phyag 'tshal/ /rang rig dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /ting 'dzin nyi ma'i 'od gdal bas/ /rang byung ye shes chos nyid klong*/ /sna tshogs rang grol la phyag 'tshal/ /lta spyod zung du 'jug pa yis/ /ting 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /bla med snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /bde legs rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i klong*/ /'khor 'das gzhi grol mnyam pa nyid/ /rtog pa mchog gyur 'gro ba 'dren/

/ma ti maṃ ga la phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs bral rtogs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /'od gsal nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /byang sems kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab mo'i de nyid rab rtogs nas/ /gnyis med rang byung ye shes la/ /'gro ba ma lus 'god mdzad pa/ /sprul sku bsam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rang byung ye shes sgom pa nyid/ /bar mtshams med par rab rtogs nas/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sar 'god pa/ /nam mkha' gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje rang shar rig pa nyid/ /rang grol chos sku rab rtogs nas/ /tshad med phrin las gzhan don 'grub/ /chos dbyings rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /ji ltar ji snyed mkhyen pa rgyas/ /brtse bas mkha' mnyam rab bsgral nas/ /thams cad gdod mar 'khrid mdzad pa/ /ma ti dhwa dza la phyag 'tshal/ /ye grol blo 'das ngang nyid nas/ /rang babs lhug par nyams blangs shing*/ /'gro la snying rje ma ltar brtse/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan yang bla ma yi dam dang*/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la/ /rtag tu gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /de snyed lus kun rnam sprul te/ /lus btud pas ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /mkhan po de ni slob dpon mchog /bshes gnyen dam pa ma lus dang*/ /sku gzugs mchod rten la sogs pa/ /mchod 'os kun la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spos dang me tog mar me dang*/ /dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun bkang ste mchod/ /thog ma med nas lus dang ngag /yid kyi sdig pa'i las bgyis pa/ /thams cad mchod 'os rnams la bshags/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag dag par mdzod/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi dge 'dun la/ /ngo mtshar kun nas rab dad pas/ /rtag par rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/

/mgon po sras dang bcas rnams la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid par/ /sku tshe phrin las mtha' yas kyis/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs nas kyang*/ /'gro ba'i mgon por mdzad du gsol/ /dge ba 'di dang gzhan dag gi /dge ba rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyis/ /'gro ba sems can ma lus pa/ /thar pa'i byang chub thob par shog /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba ci yod pa/ /'gro ba kun la rab smin te/ /bde dga'i mya ngan 'das thob shog / sems can sdug bsngal ci yod pa/ /de kun bdag gis khur khyer te/ /las dang bag chags rab sbyangs nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog / rgyal ba sras bcas ji snyed kyi/ /mdzad pa thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /de nyid spyod pa rlabs po che/ /bdag gis gzhan don spyod par shog /bdag la khro ba'am smod gyur tam/ /dad dam bstod par gyur kyang rung*/ /ming tsam thos pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /thar pa'i byang chub thob par shog /srid dang skye ba thams cad du/ /dpal mgon bla ma mnyes pa dang*/ /zab mo'i chos la brtson pa yis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog /thig le gsang skor gyi brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul me tog sprin gyi nags nang*/ kun tu bzang po'i khang bzangs su sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //
